newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Intl Comml Bank Jan-March sales up.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Intl Comml Bank Jan-March sales up.

text.p: Taiwan's International Commercial Bank of China, its financial strength confirmed recently by Moody's Investors Service, said on Monday its sales revenue rose 4.95 percent for the first quarter of 1997.
The bank, in a statement, reported January-to-March sales of T$8.154 billion, up from T$7.769 billion in first quarter 1996.
On March 31 Moody's confirmed the long-term deposit, Prime-1 short-term and financial strength ratings for the Taiwan bank.
